messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Elysian (enterprise / VPC) — elevated p95 latency + error spike in dedicated pool ded-pool-12 (us-west1). auto-runbook triggered. paging #incidents
maya: ack — i'm oncall, will take lead :eyes:
maya: grabbing logs and pool status; pinging @raj for pool ops
raj: saw OOM on node-7 in ded-pool-12, one rack partially degraded. pool at ~60% capacity. warm standby ded-pool-12-standby in us-west2 is healthy
maya: proposal: weighted DNS canary to us-west2 with low TTL, 10% steps, drain the degraded node. @emma-cs FYI for customer coordination
emma-cs: @maya @raj Elysian (rep: Luis) wants 10% increments and a heads-up before >50% shift. they want visible checkpoints
oncall-ada: joining in 2m for handoff
maya: ops plan (short): 1) scale standby in us-west2, 2) initiate rdns weighted update (TTL 30s), 3) shift 10% every 3m, 4) monitor p50/p95 + error-rate; rollback if error-rate > 2x baseline
raj: scaling now: `kctl scale pool ded-pool-12-standby --replicas=12` (scaling started)
incident-bot: runbook invoked: `runbook/tenant-failover.md` — operator: maya
maya: initiating DNS canary. rdns payload (examples):
```
POST /v1/rdns/update
{
  "zone": "elysian.app",
  "record": "api.elysian.app",
  "weights": {"us-west1": 90, "us-west2": 10},
  "ttl": 30
}
```
maya: initial update applied — us-west2 10%
alexg: watching model infer queues / GPU enqueue. will throttle batch-size if p95 climbs >2s
raj: started KV cache migration off node-7: `kv-migrate --from node-7 --to node-21` (progress 30%)
maya: 3m check: us-west1 p95 ~420ms -> 410ms, us-west2 p95 ~680ms -> 610ms, errors stable. proceeding to next step
emma-cs: updated Luis; he confirms okay to continue
maya: updating weights -> us-west1 80 / us-west2 20
incident-bot: auto-escalation threshold set: error-rate > 2x baseline => auto-fallback to previous weights
oncall-ada: taking active coord from @maya. leaving runbook notes in thread — will continue increments
maya: handing off: scaled standby=12, KV migration in progress, current weights 80/20, cadence 3m, rollback triggers set
oncall-ada: ack. next shift in ~30s
oncall-ada: weights -> 70/30
alexg: seeing modest GPU enque growth in us-west2; reducing batch_size canary 16 -> 12
oncall-ada: weights -> 60/40
raj: KV migration finished, node-7 drained and cordoned. freed capacity reclaimed
oncall-ada: weights -> 50/50 (halfway)
emma-cs: customer requests stretch between steps by +1m — Luis wants extra window for observability
oncall-ada: acknowledged; adjusting cadence to 4m between steps
incident-bot: note: DNS TTL 30s; final cutover will set us-west2 as primary when weights reach 100%
oncall-ada: continuing: 40/60 -> 30/70 -> 20/80 -> 10/90 -> 0/100 (tracking)
alexg: prepping quant config change for us-west2 at final cutover to reduce memory (q4-dyn)
oncall-ada: final update applied, now 0/100 (all traffic to us-west2). running post-cutover checks
oncall-ada: post-cutover: p50/p95 within expected bands, error-rate at baseline, no elevated 5xxs, caches warmed
emma-cs: Luis confirms they see normal traffic and metrics on their side :tada:
maya: thanks team. i'll file a detailed incident writeup (timeline + RCA) and attach rdns change IDs + kctl logs
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> ticket #INC-2026-4582. severity: high (mitigated). Please attach logs and close after RCA
oncall-ada: handoff complete, attaching notes and change IDs to the ticket, closing coordination
maya: resolved for oncall rotation — stepping down
